title: OA TABLE 73 - the daily events: the twenty-eight die-range rows of the five location columns with the twenty-nine event names and the frequency chart
audit_comment: OA round eighty-eight (capture pp. 247-248): Table 73 - the daily events grid, the twenty-eight die-range rows across the five location columns with the twenty-nine event names, plus the frequency chart, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA TABLE 73, printed capture pp. 247-248 - the daily events round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE GRID: the twenty-eight die-range rows of the daily events across the percentile die, the ranges contiguous and complete 1-100, each row read across the five location columns - the court, the city/town, the rural, the wilderness, the ocean. THE TWENTY-NINE NAMES by ordinal: Bandit Camp the 1; Bandits the 2; Becalmed the 3; Contest the 4; Crime the 5; Duel the 6; Entreaty the 7; Fire Small the 8; Haunting the 9; Illness the 10; Insult the 11; Invitation the 12; Kidnapping the 13; Land the 14; Maiden the 15; Monster the 16; Mystery the 17; No Event the 18; Nobles the 19; Pirates the 20; Plot the 21; Ruins the 22; Ship the 23; Shrine the 24; Special the 25; Storm the 26; Stranger the 27; Traveler the 28; VIP the 29. THE OPEN: the rows 01-50 No Event in all five columns, the first possible event at 51. THE FREQUENCY CHART: the events possible per day by location - court 0-1, city and town 0-1, rural 0-2, wilderness 0-3, sea and ocean 0-2; the roll on the column best fitting the location, the maximum rolled for the area (three die rolls in wilderness), many rolls no event. THE OCR REPAIR: the row 88 cell-drop resolved to Shrine/Ruins/Ship per the column bands. The grid codifies per the R431 calculus
